title: Bala Baiana
description: A delicious Brazilian coconut dessert consisting of coconut balls with a crunchy candied sugar coating.
steps: Melt butter in a pan on medium heat.
Add sweetened condensed milk and shredded coconut flakes to the pan.
Cook down on medium heat, stirring constantly, until the mixture starts pulling away from the pan.
Remove from heat and scrape the mixture into a bowl.
Cover the bowl and refrigerate for a few hours until fully cooled.
Grease your hands, grab about a tablespoon of the mixture, and roll into a ball.
Place balls on parchment paper and insert a toothpick into each one.
Combine sugar, water, and vinegar in a pan.
Boil until it turns into a golden brown color.
Dip the coconut balls quickly into the syrup and place back on parchment paper to harden.
notes:
Ensure the coconut mixture is fully cooled before rolling to make handling easier.
